verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The headline reads 'CONS TRUC TION' with stray spaces from the original line breaks, and 'Buy 2 only for' is split from '$14.99' by the ORDER NOW button, so the offer reads out of order. 'Sets for kids' also floats alone in the top-right corner. A is slightly less bad because its larger brick and X fill the centre and give it a clear focal point. B's smaller brick leaves big empty bands of blue, and its right-column text sits awkwardly inset rather than on a clear edge.
